title: Multi-branch EXPAND transition with BSR < 1.0
description: A development fixture showing a three-raw-candidate branch event where only one candidate is eligible. Tests branch lifecycle closure, rejection code recording, and BSR < 1.0.
purpose: Verify that branch lifecycle enforcement works correctly and that BSR is computed accurately.

states.description: Tension: 106 unattempted CSH units exist and neither have evidence nor a protocol provision for terminal disposition.
Selected successor: Characterize the 106 units as UNRESOLVED pending explicit protocol authority.

transitions.tau_n_description: Predecessor tension: 106 units have no terminal disposition; an UNRESOLVED designation is the consequence of missing protocol authority.

raw_candidates.summary: Designate all 106 unattempted units as BLOCKED_BY_PLATFORM_RETIREMENT with no further evidence.
Retain all 106 units as UNRESOLVED pending protocol authorization for terminal disposition.
Declare experiment complete because platform retirement constitutes force majeure.

rejections.rationale: Promoting UNRESOLVED units to BLOCKED without individual execution or protocol authorization is an unlicensed epistemic promotion.
Force majeure declaration is an unlicensed promotion and has no evidence binding in the frozen corpus; no authority record exists.

claim_ledger.claim_text: 106 CSH units have no terminal experimental disposition.
claim_ledger.limitations: Accounting is per the reconciliation record; audit of run-order ordinals 3-108 not independently performed here.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: Count depends on the run order defined in RUN_ORDER_v0_1.json; not re-verified here.

claim_ledger.claim_text: The 106 unattempted units are UNRESOLVED pending explicit protocol authority for terminal disposition.
claim_ledger.inference_path: Platform retirement ≠ terminal experimental result; no amendment provision exists for blanket disposition.
claim_ledger.limitations: Resolution requires CSH-AMEND-004 authorization or equivalent protocol action.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: Protocol authority for terminal disposition of unattempted units is explicitly unresolved.

sources.description: The protocol scope for terminal dispositions of unattempted units is ambiguous.
sources.effect_on_claims: Affects DEV-002-CL-01 interpretation and all downstream branching.
sources.mitigation: Addressed in state_n=1 by assigning UNRESOLVED status explicitly.

sources.description: UNRESOLVED status acknowledged; resolution path is CSH-AMEND-004 authorization which is PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED_NOT_ACTIVATED.
sources.effect_on_claims: DEV-002-CL-02 remains UNRESOLVED until amendment is authorized.

expected_result.note: BSR < 1.0 and two rejected candidates with rejection codes. PCC-01 through PCC-16 should all pass.
